name: zcode-plugin-prompt-enhancer
description: Prompt enhancer plugin for ZCode: desktop input-box button + /enhance-prompt command + enhance_prompt MCP tool (GLM / OpenAI-compatible / Anthropic providers).

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.overlay.json && node scripts/embed-system-prompt.mjs
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.overlay.json && node scripts/stamp-overlay-version.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test "dist-test/test/*.test.js" "test/desktop-*.test.mjs"
